content:
Maya (Product): Pinned ask from FinReg: they want an "evidence bundle" experience in the Console — show per-tenant cost deltas by route and let auditors request a signed, redacted trace bundle for a date range. We need an MVP plan and launch criteria.
Harper (Eng): Quick tech constraints: exact per-token lineage is hard with current cache/quantization layers. For MVP we can provide per-request estimated cost (input_length estimate * cost_per_token) + deterministic sampled bundles. Emphasis on 'signed' and 'verifiable' bundles.
Noah (SRE): Ops considerations: storage and export egress are the big costs. Proposal: 7d hot index for UI, 90d archival for bundles in cold storage. Default sampling 0.5% (configurable per-tenant). Add watermarking to bundles so auditors can validate freshness.
Lina (Security): Redaction must be demonstrable. Implementation note: redaction runs in the pipeline before any persistent store. We keep redaction metadata (pattern_id, rule_version, match_count) and include that in the bundle manifest. No raw PII retained. Key requirements: signed bundle (KMS), and an HMAC chain-of-custody file.
Priya (Compliance): For pilot acceptance we need: export format (CSV or Parquet), redaction manifest, and a short attestation that the redaction ruleset version X was applied. FinReg prefers Parquet for schema stability, but CSV is acceptable. Also confirm retention windows.
Diego (Customer Success): I'll collect FinReg's exact field list and whether they require chain-of-custody logs. Also will confirm if they want scheduled exports or on-demand only.
Harper (Eng): Implementation sketch:
1) Ingress hook tags tenant_id + route_id + estimated_token_count.
2) Deterministic sampler (seed = tenant_id + date) -> stream to async pipeline.
3) Redaction service runs inline to the stream, emits redaction metadata, writes redacted trace to short-term store.
4) Export job builds bundle: traces + redaction_manifest.json + signed manifest (HMAC). Put bundle in S3/GS and provide download link.
Pseudoconfig:
```
evidence_bundle:
  sampling:
    mode: deterministic
    default_rate: 0.005
    tenant_override: true
  retention:
    ui_index_days: 7
    bundle_archive_days: 90
  redaction_rules_version: "2026-03-01"
  signing_kms_key: projects/myproj/locations/global/keyRings/rb/cryptoKeys/evidence-sign
```
Maya (Product): Good. What are the launch cuts for an MVP?
Harper (Eng): MVP cuts we propose: - No per-token billing (estimate only), - Single-tenant pilot, - Limited export size (max 1k traces per export), - Minimal UI (tile + modal + export button). That should reduce scope to ~2-3 sprints.
Noah (SRE): Also cut: make exports on-demand only (no scheduled jobs) for pilot to avoid extra infra. We'll add exporter rate limits and quota. SLO: bundle generation time <30s for <=1k traces.
Lina (Security): Add CI redaction tests and a weekly verification job that re-scans a sample of stored bundles to ensure redaction hasn't regressed. Include redaction job version and checksum in manifest.
Priya (Compliance): Pilot acceptance criteria: 1) produces a signed bundle with redaction manifest, 2) Parquet/CSV schema matches FinReg sample, 3) compliance verification job runs and passes, 4) no >2% increase in request p99 during pilot.
Diego (Customer Success): I'll get FinReg schema and whether they require attestations or signed letters. ETA EOD Thu.
UI-bot: Uploaded mock: "Evidence tile" -> modal with small cost chart, "Request Evidence Bundle" button, tenant+date selector, and export status indicator. Keeping filters minimal for MVP.
Harper (Eng): Known risks to document: redaction false negatives, sampling bias (small tenants may be missed), storage blowouts if sampling misconfigured. Mitigations: tenant opt-in by default, deterministic sampling, and exporter quotas.
Noah (SRE): I'll produce a cost estimate for hot index + archive + egress per 1M requests at default sampling and include it in infra checklist.
Maya (Product): Action items: 1) Diego to collect FinReg schema + attestation ask (due Thu EOD), 2) Harper to write design doc + risk matrix (due Tue), 3) UI-bot to deliver final mock (due Wed), 4) Lina to produce security checklist and CI redaction test plan (due Wed), 5) Noah to provide retention/cost forecast and SLOs (due Wed). I'll schedule a 30m sync after docs are in.
deploy-bot: Flag created: feature/evidence-bundle-mvp :white_check_mark:
Maya (Product): If design passes, target Q2 pilot. Success metrics: pilot FinReg can download a signed evidence bundle (Parquet preferred), redaction manifest generated, bundle manifest HMAC verifies, bundle generation <30s for <=1k traces, and no >2% p99 regression. Thanks fam.
Harper (Eng): Will call out a rollback plan (disable sampling + revoke download links) in the doc.
Noah (SRE): Also will include an ops runbook for expired bundles and manual export support.
Maya (Product): Great. Closing thread until design PR. Thanks all.
